purpose: Define the minimum evidence envelope required before any Worldshepherd workstream can be promoted to partner_test maturity.

field_rules.partner_organization: Must be an external organization or separately governed external test authority; Worldshepherd self-review is insufficient.
field_rules.partner_authority_role: Must identify the role authorized to provide the test article/data/environment or accept the test scope.
field_rules.written_scope_sha256: Must be a lowercase 64-hex SHA-256 digest bound to the retained scope record.
field_rules.data_use_rights_state: Must explicitly state authorized, restricted-with-controls, or not-authorized. not-authorized fails the envelope.
field_rules.classification_or_sensitivity_state: Must explicitly identify public, proprietary, FCI, CUI/CDI, export-controlled, classified, personal/regulated, or another reviewed category. Unknown fails the envelope.
field_rules.predeclared_metrics: Must be fixed before outcome inspection. Later additions require a new version and may not replace failed original metrics.
field_rules.acceptance_thresholds: Must be fixed before outcome inspection; no retrospective threshold change is permitted.
field_rules.execution_environment: Must identify the partner-approved environment and applicable safety/security boundary.
field_rules.input_or_dataset_sha256: Must bind the exact test input or manifest; live feeds require an immutable capture/manifest strategy.
field_rules.raw_results_sha256: Must bind raw retained outputs, including failures and nulls.
field_rules.partner_review_sha256: Must bind the external review/acknowledgment record.
field_rules.claims_boundary: Must state what the test does and does not establish. A partner test cannot imply certification, qualification, customer adoption, universal performance, or independent replication unless separately evidenced.

automatic_reject_conditions: Worldshepherd is the only reviewer or test authority
written scope is absent or not digest-bound
data-use rights are unknown or not authorized
metrics or acceptance thresholds were changed after result inspection without preserving the original campaign
input, protocol, environment or results are not reproducibly identified
promotion_rule: A workstream may be proposed for partner_test maturity only after an envelope satisfies every required field and reject condition, the existing workstream-specific external gate matches the test, and the evidence is independently reviewed under the portfolio governance process. No envelope alone changes maturity automatically.
security_dependency: Executable software deployment from PR #62 is blocked while security/premerge_security_gate.v1.json has merge_allowed=false. Non-executable protocol review and planning may continue.
boeing_marketplace_boundary: This contract does not authorize Boeing/Spirit or marketplace outreach and cannot bypass any target-specific 98.7 contact gate.
claims_boundary: The existence or completeness of this contract is preparation evidence only. It does not constitute a partner test, external validation, certification, qualification, customer interest, or commercial outcome.
